title: Charging cost, promotions, and efficiency figures
summary: Feedback in this topic centers on charging promotions, electricity cost comparisons, and isolated kWh or mi/kWh efficiency figures, with many fragments too brief to support a clear sentiment.

positive.summary: The positive review praises the vehicle purchase promotion as especially attractive.

negative.summary: The negative review complains that charging electricity through one provider is costly compared with alternatives.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention kWh amounts, promotion limits, and efficiency or range figures without enough context to determine sentiment.

limitations: Several fragments are very short numeric statements, which limits reliable sentiment interpretation.
This topic mixes distinct subjects including purchase promotion, charging cost, and efficiency or range figures rather than one clearly unified issue.
Examples are few, so the available evidence is insufficient to support broader conclusions beyond these sampled fragments.
